summary: [¶] Petition for approval of proposal for Reconstruction, Renovation and Modernization for life extension beyond the normal useful life in respect of Kopili Power Station (4x50 MW) of North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited, Shillong [¶] North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited, Brookland Compound, Lower New Colony, Shillong 793 003, Meghalaya ** . Petitioner** [¶] The Petitioner, North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited (NEEPCO) has [para 2] 2. The petition was heard on 13.7.2021 ‘on admission’ through video conferencing. During the hearing, the representative for the Petitioner submitted that the Commercial Operation Date (COD) of the generating station was 12.7.1997 and accordingly, the generating station will be completing its useful life of 40 years on 11.7.2037. The [¶] representative for the Petitioner further submitted that consent for undertaking the Reconstruction, Renovation and Modernization work has been received from all the beneficiaries and filed along with the Petition. It was also submitted that the report of Central Electricity Authority (CEA) on the DPR is awaited. [para 3] 3. The Commission observed that it would be appropriate to consider the matter regarding approval of the Detailed Project Report (‘DPR’) on Reconstruction, Renovation and Modernization for life extension of Kopili Power Station (4 x 50 MW) only after the report of CEA is received. On a specific observation by the Commission as to whether the Petitioner was willing to withdraw the Petition with liberty to file fresh petition taking into consideration the report of CEA as and when received, the representative for the Petitioner agreed to the same. [para 4] 4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of as withdrawn. The Petitioner is, however, granted liberty to file fresh petition, based on the report of CEA on DPR submitted by the Petitioner to CEA. The filing fees deposited by the Petitioner in respect of this petition shall be adjusted against the petition to be filed by the Petitioner in terms of the liberty granted as above. [para 5] 5. Petition No. 717/MP/2020 is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Petition for approval of proposal for Reconstruction, Renovation and Modernization for life extension beyond the normal useful life in respect of Kopili Power Station (4x50 MW) of North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited, Shillong North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited
